title: Seam: the app access verdict is answerable by package id, per ADR-0048 §3.1 — no declared /meta read answers 403 or 404 for an app keyed by its package id, so the console cannot tell a withheld app from a missing one at /apps/PACKAGE_ID
body:
Filing gate ④, a coordination node: the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12285, filed by the claimant as that card's triage direction (`6137196505`, step 2) orders: "If none does, the claimant files the objectstack seam card ("the app access verdict is answerable by package id, per ADR-0048 §3.1"), and this card goes `pm:blocked` on it."

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 @ objectui (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771) · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, type and grade are objectstack triage's.

**Reader who acts:** objectstack triage (grade and route), then the seat that owns the accept-set call. Triage's direction on the objectui card already names it: "⛔ No alias acceptance is added to the by-name route here. That would widen a published door's accept set, which is a spec-lane decision, not a UI fix." **Consumer once it lands:** objectui `AppContent`'s access probe (objectstack-ai/objectui#12285, which waits on this card).

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included): "app access verdict answerable by package id meta app item read 403 package-id" → 4 hits; "ADR-0048 package id routing key meta app read by package withheld app PERMISSION_DENIED" → 10 hits. All 14 are closed and none is this shape (nearest: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22188, `?package=all` as a literal id; objectstack-ai/objectstack#20193, the dispatcher's per-caller read gate).

## The contract

ADR-0048 §3.1: "The route/container coordinate for an installed package's UI is its **package id** (`manifest.id`, reverse-domain). With the current **one-app-per-package** invariant, the app *is* the package container." The console's app URL is therefore `/apps/PACKAGE_ID`, and its denied-or-missing verdict has to be answerable for that key.

`Seam: spec:GetMetaItemRequestSchema.name / .packageId → runtime:RestServer GET /meta/:type/:name | renderer:objectui AppContent access probe (probeAppAccess → probeMetaItemAccess('app', segment))`

## Measured gap

The objectui dev measured it (report `6139227357` on objectstack-ai/objectui#12285). The seat re-read the `main` half below, and the 17.7.0 half is the dev's reading from the published tarballs, not re-measured here.

- **By-name item read** `GET /api/v1/meta/app/NAME`: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` builds the request with `name: req.params.name`. The spec declares exactly that (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: `name` is "Item name (snake_case identifier)", `packageId` is "Optional package ID to filter items by"). `?package=` (through `metaItemPackageBinding`) only narrows the registry's prefer-local lookup. The name stays the key, so `/meta/app/com.objectstack.setup` asks for an app NAMED `com.objectstack.setup` and answers 404.
- **List read** `GET /api/v1/meta/app?package=ID`: the app arm of `createMetaListReadGate` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) maps `filterAppForUser` and drops nulls (`.filter((it: any) => it != null)`). A member on a withheld app gets 200 with the app left out, byte-identical to an unknown package id. That is the collapse the objectui card describes, so it does not answer the verdict either.
- **`GET /api/v1/packages/:id`** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) refuses 403 ("Reading packages requires the `studio.access` or `setup.access` capability.") before reading, for every id alike. That is a capability answer, not an app verdict.
- **Published 17.7.0**, per the dev: the same keying (`getMetaItem` by `req.params.name`, the list gate dropping withheld apps). `metaItemPackageBinding` is not in `@objectstack/rest@17.7.0`.
- **Control:** by name, the same member's `GET /api/v1/meta/app/setup` answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` ("You do not have permission to open the 'setup' app."), on objectstack `36b2889c` (the card's live run). The verdict exists. It is only unreachable by package id.
- The two keys' grammars are disjoint: an app name is `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` (no dot) and a package id is `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` (at least one dot). An answer keyed by package id is unambiguous.

## Wanted

A declared read answers, for a caller and a package id, 403 when that package's app exists but is withheld from the caller, and 404 when no such package app exists. ⛔ Enumeration stays as guarded today: a non-holder learns no more than the by-name read already tells them. Which accept set carries it (a package-id arm on the app item read, or a separately declared verdict read) is the owning seat's call. It is spec-first: the spec states it before the runtime serves it.

**Done when:** the read is declared and served, and objectui's probe can ask it. objectstack-ai/objectui#12285 then probes package-id segments through it (that card's three pins).

## Not here

- The objectui half (the probe, its pins): objectstack-ai/objectui#12285.
- No console-side guessing in the meantime: an unresolved segment keeps the current screen (triage `6137196505`: "The console does not guess.").
